Inputs Situation a) Water Reservoir Status: As of February 27, 2025, the live storage in 155 major reservoirs is 93.53 BCM (52% of total capacity). Storage is at 119% of last year’s level and 115% of the 10- year average. The overall storage position is better than the corresponding period of last year in the country as a whole and is also better than the Normal storage during the corresponding period. b) Groundwater Levels: Approximately 66.6% of monitoring wells show water levels between 0- 5 m, while 29.1% report levels between 5-10 m. Decadal analysis (2014–2023) indicates a rise in 64.9% of wells and a decline in 35.1% as of August 2024. c) Seeds and Fertilizers: For Rabi 2024-25, certified seed availability is 337.98 lakh quintals against a requirement of 307.07 lakh quintals, ensuring a surplus of 30.90 lakh quintals. The fertilizer supply remains stable across all products. 6. Pests & Diseases: The overall intensity of pests and diseases remained below the Economic Threshold Level (ETL) and no major pest incidence was reported. 7. chunks.heading: 2. TEMPERATURE: MIN & MAX
chunks.text:
Temperature Forecast 27th Feb – 05th Mar 2025 a) A gradual decrease in maximum temperatures by 3-5°C is likely over Northwest India during next two days, and gradual rise by 4-6°C thereafter. b) No significant changes in maximum temperature over West India for the next 24 hours, and gradual increase of 2-3°C thereafter. c) No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over rest parts of India during next 4-5 days. d) No significant change in minimum temperatures likely over Northwest India during next 2 days and gradual fall by 2-4°C thereafter. No significant change in minimum temperatures likely over rest parts of India during most days of the week. 06th Mar - 12th Mar, 2025 e) Maximum temperatures are likely to be above normal by 2-3°C over many parts of northwest India and along west & east coast of India. It is likely to be near normal or below normal over rest parts of the country. f) There is low to moderate probability of heat wave conditions over Gujarat, Konkan and coastal Karnataka during some days of the week.
| 5 g) Minimum temperatures are likely to be below normal or near normal over most parts of the country except Western Himalayan Region, where it is likely to be above normal 2- 3°C.
